payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into the performance differences between LM-Base and CGExpan on user-generated datasets, highlighting specific factors that contribute to LM-Base's improved performance.

claims.text: LM-Base outperforms CGExpan on user-generated text due to its ability to handle the unique characteristics of such text better than SOTA methods.

Simpler baseline methods like LM-Base perform significantly better than SOTA methods on user-generated text benchmarks, indicating that complexity does not always equate to better performance in this context.
The performance of SOTA methods like CGExpan does not generalize well to user-generated text, leading to larger performance drops compared to simpler methods like LM-Base.
LM-Base shows lower performance drops than CGExpan when evaluated on user-generated text, suggesting it is more robust to the challenges presented by such datasets.
